newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asian Terminals sees net, revenues rising.
newsitem.headline: Asian Terminals sees net, revenues rising.

text.p: Asian Terminals Inc said on Thursday that it expected net profits to rise to 350 million pesos in the 1996-97 fiscal year ending June 30 against 279 million pesos in the previous year.
Executive Vice President Richard Barclay told an analysts briefing that net profits were expected to rise to 445 million pesos in the 1997-98 year.
Barclay said the port operator expects to post revenues of 2.652 billion pesos in 1996-97 against 1.527 billion pesos in the previous year.
He forecast 1997-98 revenues at 3.089 billion pesos.
Earlier on Thursday, Asian Terminals said it made a net profit of 163.55 million pesos in the six months to December 31 on revenues of 1.070 billion pesos.
